overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines only because the leading semicolon disappears when aTable is omitted ("ADD RECORD ( aTable {; *} )" vs. "ADD RECORD ( * )"). Semantically this is one overload with both aTable and * independently optional: ADD RECORD, ADD RECORD(aTable), ADD RECORD(*), and ADD RECORD(aTable;*) are all valid calls.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to use for data entry, or the default table if omitted.
If passed, the data-entry window is drawn without scroll bars and cannot be reduced.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Lets the user interactively add a new record to aTable (or the default table), displaying the current input form until the record is accepted or canceled.
